name: Uras Game Box for Oyunlar1.io
author: Uras Önder

sections.description:
Uras Game Box shows a list of free HTML5 browser games from oyunlar1.io on your WordPress site. Add it to any post or page with a shortcode, or to a sidebar with the widget. Visitors click a game card to open and play the game on oyunlar1.io, with nothing to download.

This plugin is developed independently and is not an official product of oyunlar1.io.

Features:

  • Four lists: top rated, most played, new and random games
  • Filter by category (for example racing, puzzle or 2-player games)
  • Four layouts: dark box, card grid, compact list and images only
  • Settings for width, alignment, columns, font size, corner radius, spacing and colors
  • Live preview on the settings page
  • Sidebar widget and shortcode
  • Responsive, lightweight markup with lazy-loaded images
  • Game data is cached for 6 hours, so your site stays fast
  • No ads and no tracking

External services

This plugin connects to the oyunlar1.io games API to get the list of games it displays.

  • Service: oyunlar1.io games API, https://oyunlar1.io/api/oyunlar.php
  • What is sent: only the selected list type, number of games and category. No personal data about your site visitors is sent.
  • When: from your server, only when the cached list is missing or expired (at most once every 6 hours per list).
  • Game thumbnails are loaded by your visitors’ browsers directly from oyunlar1.io, and clicking a game opens its page on oyunlar1.io.

Privacy policy: oyunlar1.io/gizlilik
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. Go to Settings > Uras Game Box and choose the default list, number of games, layout and colors.
  3. Add the [uras_game_box] shortcode to a post or page, or add the “Uras Game Box for Oyunlar1.io” widget under Appearance > Widgets.

Shortcode examples:

  • [uras_game_box]
  • [uras_game_box tur="encok" adet="12" sutun="4"]
  • [uras_game_box tur="yeni" kategori="araba-oyunlari" gorunum="liste" adet="6" baslik="New Racing Games"]
  • [uras_game_box genislik="800" hizala="orta"]

Shortcode attributes:

  • tur – list type: enguzel (top rated), encok (most played), yeni (new), rastgele (random)
  • adet – number of games (1–48)
  • gorunum – layout: kutu (box), izgara (grid), liste (list), resim (images only)
  • sutun – number of columns
  • kategori – category slug on oyunlar1.io
  • baslik – title shown above the games
  • genislik – maximum width in pixels, hizala – alignment: sol, orta, sag
  • satir, yazi, kose, bosluk, arka, renk, vurgu – title lines, font size, corner radius, spacing, background, text and accent colors
sections.faq:
Are the games played on my site?

No. Game cards open the game page on oyunlar1.io, in a new tab by default.

How do I show the “Games: oyunlar1.io” link?

It is off by default. You can turn it on under Settings > Uras Game Box.

Is the plugin translated?

The plugin includes a Turkish translation.
